parsed.english: For every k ≥ 2, R_k ≥ (k^{1/3} / (6 e^38 log k))^k, where R_k is the least n such that every k-colouring of the edges of the complete graph on n vertices has a monochromatic triangle. Moreover, for every real M there is N such that R_k^{1/k} ≥ M for all k ≥ N, i.e. R_k^{1/k} → ∞.
